notes.title: Major update - 1.0.05
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/ac3067f18737e25e32fbf54759aba2f50249441f.png"]

New character: Anubis the Immortal!

Fires scythes that home on an enemy until it dies.

Spell that freezes enemies around you.

IMMORTAL: Once Anubis joins you, he is there for good. If Anubis dies during a stage, he will return to your roster so you can always have him in your party (but he will lose some levels on death).

UNIQUE: Anubis is one of a kind, a special hero, a god of death. So you can only have one.

You can unlock Anubis by killing his Boss version, which is waiting for you at the end of the endless mode.

Includes new Steam achievements for Anubis.



New game mode: Boss Rush!

Get swarmed by bosses and see if you can survive for a full hour!

All of the enemies are mini-boss versions of the normal enemies, plus frequent “caged” boss events.

Unlock after completing stage 5.

New Steam achievements for progressing in Boss Rush mode.



Balance changes:

Most stages are now longer and more difficult.

Rebalanced enemies: Most are faster and have higher HP, but lower damage.

Healing potions can now be attracted from a distance, making them easier to collect.

Limited damage to characters, so even a very powerful enemy will not one-shot you immediately.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.04
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/18a61d29f0687662ac90234cd49cd3a6e0735680.png

Bug fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused bosses to sometimes not spawn.
Fixed drag and drop issues in the character selection screen.
Fixed a bug where the in-game character upgrades menu sometimes couldn’t be closed.
Fixed missing or wrong texts in some languages.


Balance changes:

Reduced difficulty for final endless mode boss wave.
Nerfed cold damage to only slow down enemies, instead of completely stopping them.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.03
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/b0548ed8a7bc5d3a33888a7675f6bb224681a563.png

Patch Notes - 1.0.03 

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the endless mode sometimes didn’t end after the time had passed.
 Major performance improvements, especially for the end of the endless mode but not just.
 Fixed a bug where enemies would stop dropping loot if there are too many items on the ground.
 Endless mode time is now capped at 99:59.
 Resolved an issue where sometimes bosses would spawn with less than max health (or even at 0 health).
 Cages and anvils should now spawn at some distance away from obstacles, except in rare cases.
 Game over screen after completing an endless mode run should now display the correct amount of gold.

notes.title: Dev Log 7 - Towards the Release
notes.notes:
Greeting Heroes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/0e3ee1ac960c8a5bac8d4ddb90e01f54eb29b6ad.png

As we’re getting close to the release of Fur and Fables, today we’ll do a series of tips for anyone getting into the game.

The Basics
Fur and Fables is a bullet-heaven roguelike. You control a party of animal heroes, each with their own attacks and special abilities.
Once your party of characters is ready, you’ll take them on adventures where they’ll have to survive for a set period of time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/54e8025dfc540e1c1e2287e1fa4b2b0a5894b35c.gif

Progression
When you defeat enemies, you’ll gain gold and experience points, both of which can be used to boost your permanent progression.
Experience points let you level-up your character. Characters’ stats are increased when they level up. And unlike a lot of games in the genre - your characters keep their levels, so the upgrade is permanent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/3681c3ef2a765b191ddeb8e25c7add9304ba906d.gif

Gold lets you buy permanent upgrades such as more damage, attack size, starting with a larger party, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/110a8e20981cf49e755422e4ba59fac4fabac7a4.png

Party Management
Don’t get too attached to any one hero though, as in the world of Fur and Fables, life is but a fleeting shadow and one wrong move can spell the end of even the goodest of boys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/c6757fa6c96c2baea5c74dc5b8ce9dd7d8783ff3.gif

However, you can always rescue more heroes during the game, and they will automatically join your party (if you have the space for them).
You can also recruit new heroes between stages. You should check it out regularly, as completing quests will unlock more character classes for you to recruit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911871/dbbc88b5367b3369b79c8cd76d3cce18a6a5fafe.png

Trying out different party compositions can also unlock Party Synergies: Special bonuses that you only get when you have certain character classes in your party.
They can compensate for some weak spots or just help you out in more difficult situations, so try out new combinations and find what works best for you.

And More!
There’s a lot more to explore in Fur and Fables: Weapon evolutions, in-game upgrades, spells, elemental damage, an endless mode - and plenty of content to discover for yourself!

▶️ Fur and Fables is coming April 3rd to Steam. 🔥

Watch this space for more information, and join our Discord server for all of the latest updates and discussions!
